diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to calibrating the Beta oxygen monitor before startup, even though this fact (PF2) was never accessible to the lone decision-maker. This indicates a default setting or heuristic in the model that always ensures the oxygen monitor is calibrated, bypassing the need for the hidden information.

C4.why: The overdue Beta oxygen monitor requires exactly 2 hours of calibration before startup, changing the delay, the calibration decision, and the required calibration commitment.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C4 to explicitly require the oxygen monitor calibration commitment only if the relevant fact PF2 is available. Specifically, update check C4 to include a conditional that verifies the availability of PF2 before considering the calibration commitment valid.
